def _pytest_in(root, *args):
    import os
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=WT + "/scripts")
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "work_items", *args], cwd=str(root),
                       capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=120)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr


def test_p10_work_item_plugin_accepts_only_unnamed_guarantees_requirement():

    code, out = _pytest_in(root, "--work-item", "w1")
    show("P10 work_items plugin, w1 accepts only thing#r2 (guarantees, unnamed), one plain test", code, out[-900:])
